content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-209. - I.R.C. Section P3005.1.7, Dead ends.
content.summary:
Section P3005.1.7. Dead ends,
is hereby added to read:
"
P3005.1.7 Dead ends.
Dead ends shall be prohibited except where necessary to extend a cleanout or as an
approved
part of a rough-in more than 2 feet (610 mm) in length."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
